description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Appointed to the Committee for the Health Service Sector  constituting three members for a period of one year
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the Public Service Commission appointing a committee for the Health Service Sector. It involves public sector administration and appointments within the public service framework, specifically the formation of committees to handle public service matters, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). While it names individuals, it does not involve government ministerial portfolios or structural changes (Types 1-3), nor does it fit the other specialized categories (4-7, 9).
